name: Talismans of Merit
label: Quest
description: Talismans of Merit: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to aid the cause and bring me more talismans of merit. Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Your exploits in Warsong Gulch ring throughout Ashenvale Forest.
